text:
Devon: Heads up — main went red right after the merge. Smoke alloc test failing in the GPU matrix :eyes:
CI Bot: Build 3172 failed: //smoke:allocator_smoke (shard 2)
Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/3172
Last logs:
```
error: allocator.c: oom while allocating 1.2G
stack: runtime::kv_cache_evict -> allocator_alloc
```
Maria: taking a look now, grabbing logs and the commit range
Devon: can someone kick a rerun (quick whitebox) so we know if it's flaky?
oncall: rerun started for build 3172 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/build/3172/rerun
CI Bot: Rerun 3172.1 started (triggered by oncall)
CI Bot: Rerun 3172.1 completed — still failing on same test (allocator_smoke), same stack trace
Pranav: hm, last merges: PR #2014 (sarah) altered jemalloc flags in runtime startup, PR #2015 adjusted container GPU cgroup limits. both merged ~5m before red
Sarah: I only toggled the jemalloc tuning switch (disabled aggressive decay) and added a comment — didn't touch allocator code itself. but the flag changes could affect residency
Devon: can we isolate by bisecting between commits A..B? If PR #2014 is suspect, a quick revert on main might confirm
Maria: local quick test passing for me on current branch with same docker image — suspect a scheduling/limit change (cgroup) interacting with CUDA memory accounting
Pranav: suggestion: try `bazel test //smoke:allocator_smoke --test_output=errors --runs_per_test=1` on the failing runner, and check `dmesg` for OOM killer events
Devon: also try running with prior runtime flags (re-enable aggressive decay) to see if it clears
oncall: I can run a targeted job with the old flags and report back, give me 10m
CI Bot: (debug) test command used on CI:
```
./bazel-bin/smoke/allocator_smoke --mem_limit=0.9G
```
oncall: targeted run with old jemalloc flags started -> https://ci.redwood.internal/job/3179
oncall: targeted run 3179 passed :thumbsup: (allocator_smoke green with old flags)
Sarah: ok that's suggestive — my PR's jemalloc switch likely exposed a latent memory peak. I'll open an immediate follow-up to tighten the tuning and add a guard
Devon: agree, follow-up PR good. Meanwhile we should restore green on main. who can revert PR #2014 quickly?
Maria: I can file a revert PR and request auto-merge after CI if folks agree. will tag @sarah and @pranav
Pranav: please include a small test that exercises the alloc path at CI scale, so the regression doesn't slip through next time
Sarah: thanks — I'll push a fix and a test in parallel. if revert goes through I'll still iterate on the proper jemalloc params in a follow-up PR
Devon: timeline: Maria to open revert -> oncall to trigger merge if CI green -> Sarah to open fix PR. we'll monitor for any more flakes.
Maria: created revert PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2021 — requesting review from ops and auto-merge when CI passes
Devon: thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the morning with a short postmortem note once Sarah's fix is verified. :wave:
CI Bot: build 3185 (revert PR) started
CI Bot: build 3185 passed — revert merged, main is green again
Devon: main back to green. tagging this for a brief postmortem in eng-infra tomorrow. Good catch :eyes:
